mainEntity.name: How do I know whether an AI workflow is actually improving my business instead of just generating impressive demos?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The strongest evidence is not a polished demonstration but repeated performance on your own business tasks with measurable results. Test whether the workflow reduces handling time, produces fewer missed steps, and maintains acceptable quality after human review.

**Context:** A bot library can show possible applications, but examples are not proof that every workflow produces income or works unchanged for every owner. Results depend on your niche, source material, offer, platform, integrations, and ability to review outputs.

**Key factors:**
- Baseline time and error rate before using AI.
- Number of revisions required afterward.
- Consistency across ordinary, incomplete, and unusual inputs.

**Practical guidance:** Run a small pilot for a defined period, keep before-and-after samples, and record the owner’s review time. Continue only if the workflow improves a business metric that matters, such as faster content preparation or fewer administrative backlogs.

Run My AI Business frames bot examples as adaptable educational resources, not guaranteed income-producing systems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure the workflow against a baseline. Track time spent, correction frequency, missed steps, and output quality across normal and unusual cases. A demonstration is only a starting point; your own repeated results determine whether the process is useful.
